Health SME APIs

Health SME Insurance is a specialized health insurance product provided by ART (ARG Subsidiary referred as provider) tailored to meet the needs of SME businesses. Its purpose is to offer affordable and comprehensive health coverage for employees and their relatives/dependents within SME organizations (including freelancer as long they have CR number).

Health SME

Health SME APIS

Health SME Insurance is a specialized health insurance product provided by ART (ARG Subsidiary referred as provider) tailored to meet the needs of SME businesses. Its purpose is to offer affordable and comprehensive health coverage for employees and their relatives/dependents within SME organizations (including freelancer as long they have CR number).

APIs

Get company sponsorship details

Endpoint: /cchi-count

Swagger Link

Aggregator will post a request to IC web API to this method to get CCHI (Council of Health Insurance) Minimum Count. IC will check the request and provide response (CCHI minimum count details) to Aggregator.

Request Example

                
Query Params:
    entity700Number:7003728938
    entityCR:1129384738
    quoteRequestReferenceNumber:RHL10032325121
    quoteRequestSourceId:1
    sponsorId:7011004705
    InsuranceCompanyCode:123

cURL

                
curl --location 'https://test.api-marketplace.alrajhibank.com.sa/apimarketplace-sit/sandbox-inbound/mp-health-insurance-sme/v1//cchi-count?entity700Number=7003728938&entityCR=1129384738"eRequestReferenceNumber=RHL10032325121"eRequestSourceId=1&sponsorId=7011004705&InsuranceCompanyCode=123' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer AAIgZDJiY2YwZTcyZDc5YzFkZTFkMjAyMTQxY2RlZmI1ODF69O_bVMG9ke4LrIAsMHuwERMwcJ4xKuq8SSYvme2c0tuGszJOf9GyCAbb_tZBvuzuJrOXPmwwPv6mRzEycCUwQNP9GSHAZU1hcBl_2aGgpoydSoHetqXZzqGb-4xJv9EvdUfGZYIFBxMQIfcFoROr' \
--header 'Cookie: BIGipServertest.api-marketplace.alrajhibank.com.sa-443.app~test.api-marketplace.alrajhibank.com.sa-443_pool=1815471114.24438.0000'

Verify Quote

Endpoint: /verify-quote

Swagger Link

Aggregator will post a request to ART web API to this method to ask ART to verify quote as sent in the quote and to check CCHI requirement for members minimum count.

Request Example

                                
Request Body:
{
    "Data": {
      "QuoteVerificationRequestNumber": "RHL10032325121",
      "QuoteRequestReferenceNumber": "RHL10032325122",
      "QuoteReferenceNumber": "10102414523389"
    }
  }

curl --location --globoff 'https://test.api-marketplace.alrajhibank.com.sa/apimarketplace-sit/sandbox-inbound/mp-health-insurance-sme/v1/verify-quote' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--data '{
    "Data": {
    "QuoteVerificationRequestNumber": "RHL10032325121",
    "QuoteRequestReferenceNumber": "RHL10032325122",

}'

Create Policy

Endpoint: /create-policy

Swagger Link

Endpoint: /cchi-status

Swagger Link
